film.hint: a story that you watch on a big screen
fs: Our teacher showed three old films about the sea during class.
선생님은 수업 시간에 바다에 대한 오래된 영화 세 편을 보여 주셨어요.

finally.hint: after a long time or a lot of waiting

labor.hint: hard work that you do with your body

object.hint: a thing that you can see and touch
fs: Many students objected when the school changed the lunch time last month.
지난달 학교가 점심시간을 바꾸자 많은 학생이 반대했어요.
object.fpost: when the school changed the lunch time last month.

cafe.hint: a small shop where people drink coffee and talk
fs: Many small cafes near the station open before seven in the morning.
역 근처의 작은 카페 여러 곳이 아침 7시 전에 문을 열어요.
cafe.fpost: near the station open before seven in the morning.

belong.hint: to be a part of a group or place
fs: Jiho has belonged to the school choir since he was nine.
지호는 아홉 살 때부터 학교 합창단에 속해 있어요.
belong.fpost: to the school choir since he was nine.

shuttle.hint: a bus that goes back and forth between two places
fs: Two shuttles carry the players from the hotel to the stadium every hour.
셔틀버스 두 대가 매시간 선수들을 호텔에서 경기장까지 태워다 줘요.
shuttle.fpost: carry the players from the hotel to the stadium every hour.

statement.hint: words that clearly say a fact or an opinion
fs: Tom read three statements aloud, and the class decided which were true.
톰은 진술 세 개를 소리 내어 읽었고 반 친구들은 어느 것이 맞는지 정했어요.
statement.fpost: aloud, and the class decided which were true.

swallow.hint: to move food or drink down your throat
fs: Jiho swallowed the cold water quickly and then ran back to the game.
지호는 찬물을 얼른 삼키고 경기장으로 다시 뛰어갔어요.
swallow.fpost: the cold water quickly and then ran back to the game.

later.hint: at a time that comes after now

general.hint: true or usual for most people or things
fs: Her question was more general than mine, so the answer was longer.
그 애의 질문은 내 질문보다 더 일반적이어서 답이 더 길었어요.
general.fpost: than mine, so the answer was longer.

achievement.hint: something great that you finish after working hard
fs: Our school wrote the students' achievements on a big board in the hall.
학교는 학생들의 성취를 복도의 큰 게시판에 적어 두었어요.
achievement.fpost: on a big board in the hall.

inform.hint: to tell someone about news or facts

우리는 버스가 10분 늦게 도착할 거라는 안내를 받았어요.
inform.fpost: that the bus would arrive ten minutes late.

dart.hint: a small pointed toy that you throw at a board
fs: At the party, Minsu won three games of darts against Tom.
파티에서 민수는 톰을 상대로 다트 게임에서 세 번 이겼어요.
dart.fpre: At the party, Minsu won three games of

glow.hint: to give soft light without fire

축제가 시작되자 강을 따라 등불이 은은하게 빛나고 있었어요.
glow.fpost: along the river when the festival began.

effort.hint: the energy you use to do something hard
fs: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the class finished the poster before Friday.
모두의 노력 덕분에 반이 금요일 전에 포스터를 끝냈어요.
effort.fpost: , the class finished the poster before Friday.

allergic.hint: having a bad body reaction to food or animals

ocean.hint: a very large area of salt water

많은 도시에서 나온 플라스틱이 해마다 바다로 흘러들어요.
ocean.fpre: Plastic from many cities flows into the

railroad.hint: a long path of metal tracks for trains
fs: In the 1800s, railroads helped small towns grow into big cities.
1800년대에 철도가 작은 마을이 큰 도시로 자라도록 도왔어요.
railroad.fpost: helped small towns grow into big cities.

hurricane.hint: a huge storm with strong wind and heavy rain

과학자들은 사람들에게 일찍 경고할 수 있도록 하늘에서 허리케인을 지켜봐요.
hurricane.fpost: from the sky so they can warn people early.

prefer.hint: to like one choice better than another

민수는 창가 자리를 더 원했지만 모두 차 있었어요.

ballroom.hint: a very big room where people dance

유럽의 일부 오래된 호텔에는 아직도 큰 조명이 달린 아름다운 무도회장이 있어요.
ballroom.fpre: Some old hotels in Europe still have beautiful

maid.hint: a person who cleans a house or hotel for pay

maid.fpost: were waiting at the door with a bucket and a mop.

affect.hint: to make something change in some way

지난여름 마른 날씨 때문에 많은 농장이 영향을 받았어요.
affect.fpost: by the dry weather last summer.

smoke.hint: gray gas that comes up from a fire

idm: variety is the spice of life
variety.hint: a number of different kinds of the same thing

digit.hint: one of the numbers from zero to nine

digit.fpost: on the ticket twice to make sure they matched.

bacteria.hint: very small living things that can make you sick

recognize.hint: to know someone or something because you saw it before

incredible.hint: so good or strange that it is hard to believe

아주 오래전에 선원들은 새로운 땅을 찾으려고 많은 바다를 건넜어요.

ax.hint: a tool with a heavy sharp blade for cutting wood

아주 오래전에 농부들은 땅을 개간하고 나무 집을 지으려고 도끼를 썼어요.
ax.fpost: to clear land and build wooden houses.

fear.hint: the bad feeling you have when you think of danger

재활용 센터 직원들은 금속을 종이와 플라스틱에서 가려내요.

cell phone.hint: a small device you carry to call people anywhere

학생들은 수업 시간에 휴대 전화를 가방 안에 넣어 두어야 해요.

belief.hint: the strong feeling that something is true or right

나라마다 사람들은 행운과 음식에 대해 서로 다른 믿음을 가지고 있어요.

mission.hint: an important job that a person or group must finish

과학자들은 우리 태양계의 행성들을 연구하려고 여러 임무를 계획하고 있어요.

bare.hint: not covered by clothes, a hat, or anything else

artist.hint: a person who creates pictures, songs, or statues

genius.hint: a person who is much smarter than most people

lantern.hint: a light in a case that you can carry or hang

마을 사람들은 새해를 맞아 거리를 따라 붉은 등불을 걸었어요.
lantern.fpost: along the street for the new year.

rocket.hint: a long vehicle that flies very fast into space

기술자들은 발사 전에 사막에서 강력한 로켓 두 대를 시험했어요.
rocket.fpost: in the desert before the launch.

daily.hint: happening or done once every twenty-four hours

delight.hint: a feeling of great happiness and pleasure

손주들이 모두 저녁을 먹으러 오자 할머니는 아주 기뻐하셨어요.
delight.fpost: when all her grandchildren came for dinner.

cord.hint: a long thin rope or wire that ties or connects things

organize.hint: to put things in neat order or plan an event

선생님께서 다음 달에 역사 박물관으로 가는 견학을 준비하고 계세요.

lady.hint: a polite word for a grown woman

아름다운 모자를 쓴 숙녀 두 분이 도서관에서 조용히 이야기하고 있었어요.

shear.hint: to cut the wool off a sheep

theory.hint: an idea that tries to explain why something happens

theory.fpost: before they find the right answer.

spade.hint: a tool with a flat blade for digging in the ground

아이들은 작은 삽을 해변에 가져가서 커다란 모래성을 쌓았어요.
spade.fpost: to the beach and built a big sand castle.

reaction.hint: what you say or do after something happens to you
fs: The class gave many different reactions to the surprising test result.
그 놀라운 시험 결과에 대해 반 친구들은 저마다 다른 반응을 보였어요.

cause.hint: the reason why something happens or begins

큰 소리가 내 작은 강아지를 침대 밑에 숨게 만들었어요.

respond.hint: to give an answer when someone asks or says something

respond.fpost: to the light of the sun.

admit.hint: to say that you did something or that it is true

admit.fpost: that the other team played better in the final.

lead.hint: to walk or go in front and show others the way
fs: The guide was leading the visitors through the dark cave with a small light.
안내원은 작은 불빛을 들고 어두운 동굴 안으로 방문객들을 안내하고 있었어요.
lead.fpost: the visitors through the dark cave with a small light.

engage.hint: to take part in something or keep people interested
fs: The museum is engaging visitors with a new game about space.
박물관은 우주에 관한 새 게임으로 방문객들의 관심을 사로잡고 있어요.
engage.fpost: visitors with a new game about space.

regard.hint: to think of someone or something in a certain way
fs: Long ago, farmers regarded the first rain of spring as a sign of luck.
옛날에 농부들은 봄의 첫비를 행운의 신호로 여겼어요.
regard.fpost: the first rain of spring as a sign of luck.

tap.hint: to touch something lightly and quickly with your finger
fs: The pianist tapped her foot on the floor to keep the beat.
피아니스트는 박자를 맞추려고 발로 바닥을 톡톡 쳤어요.
tap.fpost: her foot on the floor to keep the beat.

barcode.hint: a pattern of black lines that a machine can read
fs: Some old books at the library have two barcodes on the back cover.
도서관의 어떤 오래된 책들은 뒤표지에 바코드가 두 개 있어요.

penny.hint: a small coin worth one cent in the United States

penny.fpost: fell out of the old purse and rolled across the kitchen floor.

according.hint: used to say where information or an idea comes from

comic.hint: making people laugh because it is funny or silly

많은 신문이 독자들이 즐기도록 마지막 쪽에 만화를 실어요.

separate.hint: to keep things apart or take one from another

suggestion.hint: an idea that you tell someone about to help them

paste.hint: a soft sticky mixture that you can spread or use as glue

미나는 학교 축제를 위해 큰 포스터에 작은 사진들을 붙이고 있어요.
paste.fpost: small photos onto a big poster for the school fair.

inspire.hint: to make a person feel ready to try something new

박물관의 아름다운 그림들은 에이미가 매일 그림을 그리도록 마음을 북돋웠어요.

rust.hint: to become red and weak because of water and air

rust.fpost: , so Dad bought a new pair.

prohibit.hint: to say by rule or law that people cannot do something

이 호수는 물이 아주 깊어서 수영이 금지되어 있어요.
prohibit.fpost: in this lake because the water is very deep.

crystal.hint: a hard, clear stone that shines when light touches it

가장 추운 겨울 아침에 창문 유리를 얼음 결정이 덮었어요.

grammar.hint: the rules for how words are put together in sentences

represent.hint: to act for a group or to stand for something

배지 위의 별 하나하나는 우리 동아리 학생 한 명을 나타내고 있어요.

mainly.hint: used to talk about the biggest or most important part

vote.hint: to pick a choice by raising a hand or marking paper

element.hint: one basic part of something larger

mathematical.hint: connected with numbers, shapes, and counting

except.hint: used to show one person or thing is not included

긴 교통 정체가 우리 버스 기사님을 걱정시켜서 기사님은 학교에 전화했어요.
concern.fpost: our bus driver, so he called the school.

detect.hint: to find or notice something that is hard to see
fs: The new machine at the airport detected a tiny metal key in my bag.
공항의 새 기계가 내 가방 속의 작은 금속 열쇠를 알아냈어요.
detect.fpre: The new machine at the airport
detect.fpost: a tiny metal key in my bag.

frown.hint: to pull your eyebrows together because you are unhappy
fs: Mina frowned at the cold soup and asked the cook for a hot bowl.
미나는 식은 수프를 보고 얼굴을 찡그리며 요리사에게 따뜻한 한 그릇을 부탁했어요.
frown.fpost: at the cold soup and asked the cook for a hot bowl.

classic.hint: famous and loved for a very long time
fs: Mina read two classics about brave sailors during the summer holiday.
미나는 여름 방학 동안 용감한 선원들에 관한 명작 두 편을 읽었어요.
classic.fpost: about brave sailors during the summer holiday.

content.hint: the things that are inside a box or a book
fs: Please pour the contents of the bottle into the bucket slowly.
병 속의 내용물을 양동이에 천천히 부어 주세요.
content.fpost: of the bottle into the bucket slowly.

organic.hint: grown in a natural way without strong chemicals

bend.hint: a place where a road or river turns
fs: Jiho bent down to tie his shoes before the race started.
지호는 경기가 시작되기 전에 몸을 숙여 신발 끈을 묶었어요.
bend.fpost: down to tie his shoes before the race started.

litter.hint: small pieces of trash that people leave on the ground
fs: The sign says that littering in the park costs fifty dollars.
표지판에는 공원에서 쓰레기를 버리면 50달러를 내야 한다고 쓰여 있어요.
litter.fpost: in the park costs fifty dollars.

surface.hint: the outside or top part of something like water
fs: Wipe all the surfaces in the kitchen with a clean, wet cloth.
주방의 모든 표면을 깨끗하고 젖은 천으로 닦으세요.
surface.fpost: in the kitchen with a clean, wet cloth.

admission.hint: permission or money needed to go into a place
fs: The museum counted three hundred admissions on the first day of spring.
박물관은 봄의 첫날 입장객 300명을 세었어요.
admission.fpost: on the first day of spring.

engine.hint: a machine part that makes a car or machine move
fs: Planes with two engines can fly safely across the sea.
엔진이 두 개인 비행기는 바다를 안전하게 건너 날 수 있어요.
engine.fpost: can fly safely across the sea.

matter.hint: to be important to someone or have a big effect
fs: Small details mattered to our coach, so we checked every shoe before the race.
작은 부분이 우리 코치님께는 중요해서 우리는 경주 전에 모든 신발을 확인했어요.
matter.fpost: to our coach, so we checked every shoe before the race.

inquiry.hint: a question that you ask to get information
fs: Many inquiries came to the library about the new reading room.
새 독서실에 대한 문의가 도서관에 많이 들어왔어요.
inquiry.fpost: came to the library about the new reading room.

release.hint: to let a person or animal go free
fs: After school, Yuna released the little butterfly from her jar into the garden.
방과 후에 유나는 작은 나비를 병에서 정원으로 놓아 주었어요.
release.fpost: the little butterfly from her jar into the garden.

temper.hint: the way you act when you feel angry or calm
fs: Tempers rose in the long line, but the cashier stayed calm and smiled.
긴 줄에서 사람들의 성질이 날카로워졌지만 계산원은 침착하게 웃었어요.
temper.fpost: rose in the long line, but the cashier stayed calm and smiled.

legend.hint: an old story that people have told for many years
fs: At the festival, grandparents told legends about the sun and the moon.
축제에서 할아버지 할머니들이 해와 달에 관한 전설을 들려주셨어요.
legend.fpost: about the sun and the moon.

highway.hint: a wide road where cars can travel very fast
fs: Wide highways connect the big cities in the south of Korea.
넓은 고속도로들이 한국 남쪽의 큰 도시들을 이어 줘요.
highway.fpost: connect the big cities in the south of Korea.

miniature.hint: made much smaller than the real thing
fs: The shop sells miniatures of famous towers, bridges, and old temples.
그 가게는 유명한 탑과 다리, 옛 절의 축소 모형을 팔아요.
miniature.fpost: of famous towers, bridges, and old temples.

website.hint: a group of pages on the internet about one subject
fs: Good websites for kids have clear pictures and short, simple sentences.
어린이를 위한 좋은 웹사이트에는 선명한 그림과 짧고 쉬운 문장이 있어요.
website.fpost: for kids have clear pictures and short, simple sentences.

cent.hint: a coin worth one hundredth of a dollar
fs: The candy cost only fifty cents at the corner store.
그 사탕은 모퉁이 가게에서 50센트밖에 안 했어요.

heritage.hint: old customs and buildings that a country keeps for the future

bathtub.hint: a big container you fill with water to wash in
fs: Hotels often put bathtubs in the biggest rooms for guests.
호텔은 손님을 위해 가장 큰 방에 욕조를 놓는 경우가 많아요.
bathtub.fpost: in the biggest rooms for guests.

leap.hint: to jump high or far into the air
fs: The cat leaped onto the tall shelf and knocked down a book.
고양이가 높은 선반 위로 뛰어올라 책 한 권을 떨어뜨렸어요.
leap.fpost: onto the tall shelf and knocked down a book.

slip.hint: to slide by accident and almost fall down
fs: Amy slipped on a banana peel, but she laughed and stood up.
에이미는 바나나 껍질에 미끄러졌지만 웃으면서 일어섰어요.
slip.fpost: on a banana peel, but she laughed and stood up.

inject.hint: to put medicine or liquid into a body with a needle
fs: The scientist injected blue dye into the water to see how it moved.
과학자는 물이 어떻게 움직이는지 보려고 물에 파란 염료를 주입했어요.
inject.fpost: blue dye into the water to see how it moved.

ghost.hint: a spirit in stories that floats in the air
fs: In our school play, three ghosts wore white sheets and sang a funny song.
우리 학교 연극에서 유령 셋이 하얀 천을 두르고 웃긴 노래를 불렀어요.
ghost.fpost: wore white sheets and sang a funny song.

doping.hint: using forbidden medicine to win in a sport

symbol.hint: a picture or sign that stands for an idea

도로 표지판은 운전자가 빨리 이해할 수 있도록 간단한 기호를 써요.
symbol.fpost: so that drivers can understand them quickly.

ever.hint: at any time up to now or in the future

leather.hint: a strong material made from the skin of an animal

truth.hint: something that is real and not a lie
fs: Scientists look for new truths about space by asking careful questions.
과학자들은 조심스러운 질문을 하면서 우주에 관한 새로운 사실을 찾아요.
truth.fpost: about space by asking careful questions.

whether.hint: a word that joins two possible choices or answers

enable.hint: to make it possible for someone to do something
fs: Learning English is enabling Jiho to talk with students from other countries.
영어를 배우는 덕분에 지호는 다른 나라 학생들과 이야기할 수 있게 되고 있어요.
enable.fpost: Jiho to talk with students from other countries.

failure.hint: the state of not reaching the goal you tried for
fs: Inventors learn from their failures before they build a great machine.
발명가들은 훌륭한 기계를 만들기 전에 실패에서 배워요.
failure.fpost: before they build a great machine.

gain.hint: to get more of something little by little
fs: My little brother has gained two centimeters in height since last spring.
내 남동생은 지난봄 이후로 키가 2센티미터 늘었어요.
gain.fpost: two centimeters in height since last spring.

composer.hint: a person whose job is to write music
fs: Some composers write music for movies, and others write songs for singers.
어떤 작곡가들은 영화를 위한 음악을 쓰고, 다른 작곡가들은 가수를 위한 노래를 써요.
composer.fpost: write music for movies, and others write songs for singers.

distinct.hint: easy to see or hear because it is clearly different
fs: The sound of the drum was more distinct than the sound of the flute.
북소리는 플루트 소리보다 더 뚜렷했어요.
distinct.fpre: The sound of the drum was
distinct.fpost: than the sound of the flute.

era.hint: a long period of time known for special events

선생님들은 사람들이 서로 다른 시대에 어떻게 살았는지 보여 주려고 그림을 써요.
era.fpre: Teachers use pictures to show how people lived in different

expect.hint: to think that something will probably happen

미나는 이모가 보낸 소포가 올 거라고 생각해서 문 옆에서 기다려요.
expect.fpost: a package from her aunt, so she waits by the door.

offline.hint: not connected to the internet or a network

urban.hint: related to cities and the people who live in them

result.hint: what happens or comes out at the end of something
fs: The test results were posted on the board outside the classroom.
시험 결과가 교실 밖 게시판에 붙었어요.
result.fpost: were posted on the board outside the classroom.

portable.hint: small and light enough to carry easily
fs: This tablet is more portable than my laptop because it is so light.
이 태블릿은 아주 가벼워서 내 노트북보다 더 들고 다니기 편해요.
portable.fpost: than my laptop because it is so light.

measure.hint: to find out the size or amount of something
fs: The doctor measured my height and weight during the health check yesterday.
의사 선생님은 어제 건강 검진 때 내 키와 몸무게를 재셨어요.
measure.fpost: my height and weight during the health check yesterday.

spoil.hint: to make something bad, old, or less fun
fs: Too much salt was spoiling the soup, so Dad added more water.
소금이 너무 많아서 수프를 망치고 있었기 때문에 아빠는 물을 더 넣으셨어요.
spoil.fpost: the soup, so Dad added more water.

salvation.hint: something or someone that rescues you from trouble

sled.hint: a small vehicle that slides over snow
fs: At the winter festival, kids lined up with their sleds for a race.
겨울 축제에서 아이들은 경주를 하려고 썰매를 들고 줄을 섰어요.
sled.fpre: At the winter festival, kids lined up with their

crime.hint: an act that the law says is wrong

사회 시간에 우리는 범죄를 막으려면 왜 법이 필요한지 배웠어요.
crime.fpre: In social studies, we learned why laws are needed to stop

graduate.hint: to finish all the classes at a school

올해 졸업하는 학생들은 졸업식에서 노래를 부를 거예요.
graduate.fpost: this year will sing a song at the ceremony.

scale.hint: a tool for weighing things, or the size of something
fs: The shop has three kitchen scales, and each one shows the weight clearly.
그 가게에는 주방 저울이 세 개 있고, 저마다 무게를 또렷하게 보여 줘요.
scale.fpost: , and each one shows the weight clearly.

vivid.hint: very bright and clear to see or remember
fs: His story about the trip was more vivid than the photos on the wall.
여행에 관한 그의 이야기는 벽에 걸린 사진보다 더 생생했어요.
vivid.fpre: His story about the trip was
vivid.fpost: than the photos on the wall.

cape.hint: a loose piece of clothing worn over the shoulders
fs: At the costume party, the twins wore bright blue capes.
의상 파티에서 쌍둥이는 밝은 파란색 망토를 입었어요.
cape.fpre: At the costume party, the twins wore bright blue

dice.hint: small cubes with dots that you roll in games

crate.hint: a strong box used to carry or store things
fs: At the market, workers stacked six crates of milk next to the truck.
시장에서 일꾼들이 트럭 옆에 우유 상자 여섯 개를 쌓아 올렸어요.
crate.fpre: At the market, workers stacked six
crate.fpost: of milk next to the truck.

lyrics.hint: the words that you sing in a song

deck.hint: the flat floor of a ship where people can walk

큰 배에는 갑판이 여러 개 있는 경우가 많고, 승객들은 각 갑판에서 걸을 수 있어요.
deck.fpost: , and passengers can walk on each one.

cheat.hint: to break the rules to win or get something
fs: Cheating in a game is not fair to the other players.
게임에서 부정행위를 하는 것은 다른 선수들에게 공평하지 않아요.
cheat.fpost: in a game is not fair to the other players.

society.hint: a large group of people who live together
fs: Different societies around the world have their own holidays and foods.
세계의 여러 사회는 저마다의 명절과 음식을 가지고 있어요.
society.fpost: around the world have their own holidays and foods.

parachute.hint: a big cloth that helps a person fall slowly from the sky
fs: Many colorful parachutes came down slowly over the beach during the airshow.
알록달록한 낙하산 여러 개가 에어쇼 동안 해변 위로 천천히 내려왔어요.
parachute.fpost: came down slowly over the beach during the airshow.

chance.hint: a time when you are able to try something
fs: I gave my little brother three chances to guess the secret word.
나는 어린 동생에게 비밀 단어를 맞힐 기회를 세 번 주었어요.
chance.fpre: I gave my little brother three

essay.hint: a short piece of writing about one subject
fs: Three students read their essays aloud in front of the whole class.
학생 세 명이 반 친구들 앞에서 자기 에세이를 소리 내어 읽었어요.
essay.fpost: aloud in front of the whole class.

rack.hint: a frame or stand where you hang or place things
fs: The shop has long racks full of colorful winter jackets near the window.
그 가게에는 창가 근처에 알록달록한 겨울 재킷이 가득 걸린 긴 옷걸이가 있어요.
rack.fpost: full of colorful winter jackets near the window.

attack.hint: a fast move to get points against the other team
fs: The coach drew five different attacks on the board before the match.
코치 선생님은 경기 전에 칠판에 서로 다른 공격 작전 다섯 가지를 그렸어요.
attack.fpost: on the board before the match.

cathedral.hint: a very large and important church in a city
fs: Our teacher showed us pictures of tall cathedrals in Spain and Italy.
선생님은 우리에게 스페인과 이탈리아에 있는 높은 대성당들의 사진을 보여 주셨어요.
cathedral.fpre: Our teacher showed us pictures of tall

current.hint: happening or being used now, not in the past

센 바다 물살은 따뜻한 물을 바다의 더 차가운 곳으로 실어 날라요.
current.fpost: carry warm water to colder parts of the sea.

cattle.hint: big farm animals like cows that eat grass

theater.hint: a building where people watch plays or movies
fs: Three new theaters opened in our city during the past two years.
지난 2년 동안 우리 도시에 새 극장이 세 곳 문을 열었어요.
theater.fpost: opened in our city during the past two years.

slight.hint: very small in size or amount
fs: Her cold was slighter than her brother's, so she went to school.
그 아이의 감기는 남동생의 감기보다 가벼워서 학교에 갔어요.
slight.fpost: than her brother's, so she went to school.

relationship.hint: the way two people or things are connected to each other
fs: Good relationships with neighbors make a town feel warm and safe.
이웃과의 좋은 관계는 마을을 따뜻하고 안전하게 느끼게 해요.
relationship.fpost: with neighbors make a town feel warm and safe.

dislike.hint: to not enjoy something and think it is bad
fs: My sister has always disliked loud music, so she wears headphones.
내 여동생은 늘 시끄러운 음악을 싫어해서 헤드폰을 써요.
dislike.fpost: loud music, so she wears headphones.

lane.hint: one narrow part of a road or a pool
fs: The new highway near our town has four lanes in each direction.
우리 마을 근처의 새 고속도로는 양쪽 방향으로 각각 차선이 네 개 있어요.
lane.fpre: The new highway near our town has four

booth.hint: a small space where people sell things at a fair
fs: Rows of booths at the science fair showed robots made by students.
과학 박람회의 부스들이 줄지어 서서 학생들이 만든 로봇을 보여 주었어요.
booth.fpost: at the science fair showed robots made by students.

herbal.hint: made from plants that people use for flavor or medicine

optional.hint: something you can choose to do, but you do not have to

theme.hint: the main idea that a story, party, or show is about
fs: The book has several themes, such as friendship, courage, and honesty.
그 책에는 우정, 용기, 정직 같은 여러 주제가 있어요.
theme.fpost: , such as friendship, courage, and honesty.

addition.hint: something extra that you put with other things
fs: Two new additions joined our school band, a drummer and a violinist.
새 멤버 두 명이 우리 학교 밴드에 들어왔는데, 드럼 연주자와 바이올린 연주자예요.
addition.fpost: joined our school band, a drummer and a violinist.

chest.hint: the front part of your body between your neck and stomach

할머니는 다락방의 큰 상자 두 개에 담요를 보관하세요.
chest.fpre: Our grandmother keeps blankets in two large

pace.hint: how fast you walk, run, or do something
fs: Take five paces forward, and you will find the hidden treasure.
앞으로 다섯 걸음 걸어가면 숨겨진 보물을 찾을 수 있어요.
pace.fpost: forward, and you will find the hidden treasure.

require.hint: to need something or say that people must have it
fs: Climbing the mountain requires strong shoes and a lot of water.
그 산을 오르려면 튼튼한 신발과 많은 물이 필요해요.
require.fpost: strong shoes and a lot of water.

accept.hint: to say yes to something that someone gives or asks
fs: Mina is accepting new members for the dance club until Friday.
미나는 금요일까지 춤 동아리의 새 회원을 받고 있어요.
accept.fpost: new members for the dance club until Friday.

mode.hint: a way that a machine or a person works or acts
fs: This watch has three modes: time, alarm, and timer.
이 손목시계에는 시간, 알람, 타이머의 세 가지 모드가 있어요.

equator.hint: the invisible line that cuts the Earth into two halves

force.hint: to make someone do something they do not want to do
fs: Nobody forced me to join the club; I chose it myself.
아무도 나에게 동아리에 들라고 억지로 시키지 않았어요. 내가 직접 골랐어요.
force.fpost: me to join the club; I chose it myself.

property.hint: things or land that belong to a person or group
fs: Many old properties in this town have small gardens with stone walls.
이 마을의 오래된 집과 땅 여러 곳에는 돌담이 있는 작은 정원이 있어요.
property.fpost: in this town have small gardens with stone walls.

instrument.hint: something used to make music, like a guitar or a drum
fs: Old instruments from many countries were shown at the museum yesterday.
여러 나라의 오래된 악기들이 어제 박물관에 전시되었어요.
instrument.fpost: from many countries were shown at the museum yesterday.

grave.hint: a place in the ground where a person is buried
fs: The old graves on this hill are covered with soft green grass.
이 언덕의 오래된 묘들은 부드러운 푸른 잔디로 덮여 있어요.
grave.fpost: on this hill are covered with soft green grass.

toe.hint: one of the five small parts at the end of your foot
fs: Her shoes were so tight that her toes hurt after the walk.
그 아이의 신발이 너무 꽉 껴서 산책 뒤에 발가락이 아팠어요.
toe.fpre: Her shoes were so tight that her

institution.hint: a large organization like a school or hospital
fs: Many institutions in our country offer free classes for adults.
우리나라의 많은 기관이 어른을 위한 무료 수업을 열어요.
institution.fpost: in our country offer free classes for adults.

service.hint: help or work that someone does for other people
fs: Several new bus services connect our village to the city center.
새 버스 노선 몇 개가 우리 마을과 도심을 이어 줘요.
service.fpost: connect our village to the city center.

tip.hint: a small piece of useful advice that helps you
fs: Our coach shared five simple tips for running a long race.

physics.hint: the science of light, heat, sound, and energy

nutrient.hint: something in food that helps living things grow

local.hint: belonging to a certain town or small area

overall.hint: including everything instead of only one part

get rid of.hint: to throw away or remove something you do not want

imaginary.hint: not real and only existing in your mind

lake.hint: a large area of water with land all around

email.hint: a message you send by computer or phone

biography.hint: a book about the true story of someone's life

graphic.hint: a picture or drawing that explains information

marriage.hint: the joining of two people to become a family

danger.hint: the chance that someone may be hurt

cheesy.hint: so silly and old-fashioned that it feels awkward

ease.hint: to make pain or worry less strong

process.hint: a series of steps that you follow to make something

과학자들은 호수와 강의 물을 깨끗하게 하는 과정들을 연구해요.

간식 중에서 꿀 케이크가 가장 끈적끈적해서 우리는 숟가락을 썼어요.

도서관 동아리에서 유나는 수수께끼 세 개를 읽어 줬고 친구들이 답을 맞혀 봤어요.

미나는 게임이 끝나기 전에 모든 단서를 공책에 적었어요.
clue.fpost: in her notebook before the game ended.

이모는 시트를 전부 빨아서 햇볕에 널었어요.
sheet.fpost: and hung them in the sun.

fs: Each helper had two tasks to finish before the bell rang.
도우미들은 각자 종이 울리기 전에 끝내야 할 일이 두 가지였어요.
task.fpost: to finish before the bell rang.

제주도 여행에서 우리는 폭포 같은 아름다운 볼거리를 많이 봤어요.

fs: The nurse counted the pills and put them in a small bottle.
간호사 선생님은 알약을 세어서 작은 병에 넣으셨어요.

에이미는 삼십 분밖에 없어서 가장 간단한 요리법을 골랐어요.

fs: The two totals on the list were different, so we added again.
목록의 두 합계가 달라서 우리는 다시 더했어요.

fs: This chair is more stable than the old one because it has four strong legs.
이 의자는 튼튼한 다리가 네 개 있어서 옛 의자보다 더 안정적이에요.
stable.fpost: than the old one because it has four strong legs.

옛이야기에서 사람들은 거짓말쟁이들을 믿지 않고 정직한 친구들을 택했어요.

선장은 바다를 가로지르는 긴 여행에서 항구 네 곳을 들렀어요.
port.fpost: on his long trip across the sea.

과학자들은 거대한 얼음덩어리들이 바다로 천천히 움직이고 있다고 말했어요.
mass.fpost: of ice were slowly moving into the sea.

엄마는 파란색과 노란색 실로 작은 가방을 꿰매셨어요.

s: Last Saturday, Amy's class took a shuttle to the beach with their teacher.
지난 토요일에 에이미네 반은 선생님과 함께 셔틀버스를 타고 바닷가에 갔어요.
First, they walked along the shore, and Amy saw the wide ocean for the first time.
먼저 아이들은 해안을 따라 걸었고, 에이미는 넓은 바다를 처음 보았어요.
Then Mina preferred to collect shells, but Tom wanted to build a sand castle.
그다음에 미나는 조개껍데기를 모으는 쪽을 더 좋아했지만, 톰은 모래성을 쌓고 싶어 했어요.
After that, everyone helped Tom, and the castle soon looked incredible.
그 뒤에 모두가 톰을 도왔고, 모래성은 곧 믿을 수 없을 만큼 멋져 보였어요.
Finally, the teacher called everyone back because the shuttle would leave at five.
마지막으로 선생님은 셔틀버스가 다섯 시에 떠날 거라서 모두를 다시 불렀어요.
On the ride home, Amy was tired, but she felt happy about the day.
집에 돌아가는 길에 에이미는 피곤했지만 그날 하루가 행복했어요.
t: A Class Trip to the Beach
ox: Amy went to the beach by herself.
에이미는 혼자 바닷가에 갔어요.
Tom's classmates helped him with the castle.
톰의 반 친구들이 모래성 만드는 것을 도와줬어요.
tc: A Class Trip to the Beach
A Lonely Day on the Bus
sm: Amy's class had a fun day at the beach, built a castle, and rode home.
The class missed the shuttle and had to walk home from the beach.
Amy was sad all day because nobody wanted to play with her.
q: What would you build on the beach with your friends?
친구들과 바닷가에서 뭘 만들 거야?
ex: I would prefer to build a big sand boat with my friends.
나는 친구들과 큰 모래 배를 만드는 쪽이 더 좋아요.

s: Last month, Minsu and Yuna joined the school science fair.
지난달 민수와 유나는 학교 과학 박람회에 참가했어요.
First, their teacher informed them about the rules, so they asked how light might affect a plant.
먼저 선생님이 규칙을 알려 주셨고, 두 사람은 빛이 식물에 어떤 영향을 줄지 궁금해했어요.
Then they put one plant near the window and one in a dark box.
그다음에 식물 하나는 창문 가까이에, 하나는 어두운 상자 안에 두었어요.
After that, they made a big effort to measure both plants every morning.
그 뒤에 두 사람은 매일 아침 두 식물을 재려고 크게 노력했어요.
In the end, the judges gave them first prize for their excellent results.
결국 심사위원들은 훌륭한 결과를 낸 두 사람에게 1등상을 주었어요.
The prize was a great achievement, and both students smiled all day.
그 상은 대단한 성취였고, 두 학생은 하루 종일 웃었어요.
ox: Minsu and Yuna put both plants in a dark box.
민수와 유나는 두 식물을 모두 어두운 상자에 넣었어요.
The judges gave Minsu and Yuna first prize.
심사위원들은 민수와 유나에게 1등상을 주었어요.
tc: A Cold Day at the Lake
sm: Two students tested how light changes a plant and won first prize.
Two students forgot their plants and lost the science fair.
Minsu and Yuna played outside all day instead of working.
q: What would you test at a science fair?
과학 박람회에서 너라면 뭘 실험할래?
ex: I would test how music can affect a plant.
나는 음악이 식물에 어떤 영향을 줄 수 있는지 실험해 볼 거예요.

s: Last Friday, Mina's class had a mission to organize an art show for the school.
지난 금요일 미나네 반은 학교를 위해 미술 전시회를 준비하는 임무를 맡았어요.
First, Mina and Tom asked a local artist to visit and teach everyone how to draw.
먼저 미나와 톰은 지역 화가 한 분께 와서 모두에게 그림 그리는 법을 가르쳐 달라고 부탁했어요.
Then each student drew a picture on a single page and wrote a short title below it.
그다음에 학생들은 각자 종이 한 장에 그림을 그리고 그 아래에 짧은 제목을 썼어요.
After that, the class hung all the pages on the wall of the hallway.
그 뒤에 반 친구들은 그림 종이를 모두 복도 벽에 걸었어요.
Finally, the other students came to look, and the artist smiled with delight.
마지막으로 다른 학생들이 구경하러 왔고, 화가 선생님은 기뻐서 미소를 지었어요.
Mina felt proud because everyone enjoyed the show.
모두가 전시회를 즐겨서 미나는 뿌듯했어요.
ox: Mina's class held a sports day last Friday.
미나네 반은 지난 금요일에 운동회를 열었어요.
The students hung their drawings in the hallway.
학생들은 그림을 복도에 걸었어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Zoo
sm: Mina's class organized an art show with an artist, and everyone enjoyed it.
Mina lost her drawing and could not join the show.
The artist canceled the visit because it rained.
q: What would you draw for an art show?
미술 전시회에 너라면 뭘 그릴래?
ex: I would draw my pet dog on one page and show it to an artist.
나는 한 쪽에 우리 강아지를 그려서 화가 선생님께 보여 드릴 거예요.

s: Last summer, Jiho's family drove to a small town by the sea.
지난여름 지호네 가족은 바닷가의 작은 마을로 차를 타고 갔어요.
First, Jiho and his sister walked along the beach and found a tiny fossil in a rock.
먼저 지호와 여동생은 해변을 따라 걷다가 바위에서 작은 화석을 찾았어요.
Then he took a photo of it with his cell phone and showed it to his dad.
그다음에 지호는 휴대 전화로 화석 사진을 찍어서 아빠께 보여 드렸어요.
After that, the family ate dinner at a cafe near the harbor.
그 뒤에 가족은 항구 근처 카페에서 저녁을 먹었어요.
Finally, they walked home under a paper lantern that hung over the road.
마지막으로 가족은 길 위에 걸린 종이 등 아래로 걸어서 집에 갔어요.
Jiho said that it was his best trip of the year.
지호는 올해 최고의 여행이었다고 말했어요.
ox: Jiho's family traveled to the mountains.
지호네 가족은 산으로 여행을 갔어요.
Jiho took a photo of the fossil.
지호는 화석 사진을 찍었어요.
sm: Jiho's family went to a town by the sea, found a fossil, and had a great trip.
Jiho lost his cell phone and went home early.
Jiho's family got lost on a mountain road.
q: What would you do on a trip to the sea?
바다로 여행을 가면 너라면 뭘 할래?
ex: I would collect shells and take a picture with my cell phone.
나는 조개껍데기를 모으고 휴대 전화로 사진을 찍을 거예요.

s: Last week, Mina made a suggestion about building a small garden behind the school.
지난주에 미나는 학교 뒤에 작은 정원을 만들자고 제안했어요.
First, the class had a vote, and almost every student raised a hand for the garden.
먼저 반에서 투표를 했고, 거의 모든 학생이 정원에 찬성해서 손을 들었어요.
Then Tom and Jiho used string to separate the flower beds from the vegetable beds.
그다음에 톰과 지호는 끈을 써서 꽃밭과 채소밭을 따로 나눴어요.
After that, every student wrote a signature on the garden plan.
그 뒤에 모든 학생이 정원 계획서에 서명을 했어요.
Finally, according to the principal, the class could start digging on Monday morning.
마지막으로 교장 선생님 말씀에 따르면 반은 월요일 아침부터 땅을 파기 시작할 수 있었어요.
By the end of the month, the children had planted carrots and beans together.
그달이 끝날 무렵 아이들은 당근과 콩을 함께 심었어요.
ox: Mina wanted to build a garden inside the classroom.
미나는 교실 안에 정원을 만들고 싶어 했어요.
Tom and Jiho used string to help divide the garden.
톰과 지호는 끈으로 정원을 나누는 일을 도왔어요.
tc: A Quiet Day at the Beach
sm: Mina's garden idea won the class vote, and the students began the work.
The principal said no to the garden, so the class went home.
Tom planted a garden alone at home.
q: What would you plant in a school garden?
학교 정원에 너라면 뭘 심을래?
ex: I would plant tomatoes, and we could vote on a name for the garden.
나는 토마토를 심고, 정원 이름은 우리가 투표로 정하면 좋겠어요.

s: Last Saturday, Yuna and her brother visited a used book store near the train station.
지난 토요일에 유나와 남동생은 기차역 근처 헌책방에 갔어요.
First, her brother found a funny comic about a talking dog and a small robot.
먼저 남동생이 말하는 강아지와 작은 로봇이 나오는 웃긴 만화책을 찾았어요.
Then the clerk used a machine to scan the barcode on the back cover.
그다음에 점원이 기계로 뒤표지의 바코드를 스캔했어요.
After that, the book cost two dollars and one penny, so Yuna counted her coins carefully.
그 뒤에 책값은 2달러 1센트여서 유나는 동전을 조심스럽게 세어 봤어요.
Finally, they sat on a bench in the park and read the story together.
마지막으로 둘은 공원 벤치에 앉아 이야기를 함께 읽었어요.
The comic was mainly for young children, but Yuna enjoyed it too.
그 만화책은 주로 어린아이들을 위한 것이었지만 유나도 재미있게 읽었어요.
t: A Day at the Book Store
ox: Yuna went to the book store on Sunday.
유나는 일요일에 책방에 갔어요.
The clerk used a machine on the back cover of the book.
점원은 책의 뒤표지에 기계를 사용했어요.
tc: A Day at the Book Store
sm: Yuna and her brother bought a funny book and read it in the park.
Yuna lost her money and went home early.
Her brother sold comics to the clerk.
q: What kind of book do you like to read in the park?
공원에서 어떤 책을 읽는 걸 좋아해?
ex: I like to read a funny comic on a bench under a tree.
나는 나무 아래 벤치에서 웃긴 만화책 읽는 걸 좋아해요.

s: Last Monday morning, the whole school met in the gym for a safety assembly.
지난 월요일 아침, 전교생이 체육관에 모여 안전 조회를 했어요.
First, the principal assured the students that the disaster drill was only practice.
먼저 교장 선생님은 학생들에게 재난 대피 훈련이 연습일 뿐이라고 안심시켜 주셨어요.
Then the classes walked outside in a line and waited quietly on the field.
그다음에 반별로 줄을 서서 밖으로 나가 운동장에서 조용히 기다렸어요.
After that, Mina's class discussed what to do in a real emergency.
그 뒤에 미나네 반은 진짜 위급한 상황이 생기면 무엇을 해야 할지 의논했어요.
Finally, the teacher showed them a hotline number to call for help.
마지막으로 선생님은 도움을 청할 때 걸 수 있는 직통 전화번호를 보여 주셨어요.
Everyone felt ready, and Mina wrote the number in her notebook.
모두 준비가 된 느낌이었고, 미나는 그 번호를 공책에 적었어요.
ox: The students stayed inside their classrooms during the drill.
학생들은 훈련 동안 교실 안에 머물렀어요.
Mina's class talked about what to do in an emergency.
미나네 반은 위급한 상황에서 무엇을 해야 할지 이야기했어요.
sm: The school had a safety assembly, practiced a drill, and learned who to call.
The students canceled the drill because of rain.
Mina forgot her notebook and missed the assembly.
q: Who would you ask for help at school?
학교에서 너라면 누구에게 도움을 청할래?
ex: I would ask my teacher first, and then I would call the hotline.
나는 먼저 선생님께 부탁하고, 그다음에 직통 전화에 걸 거예요.

s: Last Saturday, Tom took his dog to the park with a red leash.
지난 토요일 톰은 빨간 목줄을 한 강아지를 데리고 공원에 갔어요.
First, they walked by the pond, and Tom found a tiny nest in a low tree.
먼저 두 사람은 연못 옆을 걸었고, 톰은 낮은 나무에서 작은 둥지를 발견했어요.
Then a jet flew over the park, and the dog barked at the loud sound.
그다음에 제트기 한 대가 공원 위로 날아갔고, 강아지는 큰 소리에 짖었어요.
After that, Tom saw a small snail that was only one inch long.
그 뒤에 톰은 길이가 겨우 1인치밖에 안 되는 작은 달팽이를 보았어요.
Finally, they met Tom's mother at the gate, and she said they could visit the park anytime.
마지막으로 두 사람은 문 앞에서 톰의 엄마를 만났고, 엄마는 언제든지 공원에 와도 된다고 말했어요.
Tom smiled, and the dog wagged its tail all the way home.
톰은 활짝 웃었고, 강아지는 집에 가는 내내 꼬리를 흔들었어요.
ox: Tom went to the park without his dog.
톰은 강아지 없이 공원에 갔어요.
A jet flew over the park.
제트기 한 대가 공원 위로 날아갔어요.
sm: Tom and his dog walked in the park, saw a nest and a jet, and were told they could return.
Tom lost his dog near the pond and went home alone.
Tom stayed home because of heavy rain.
q: What would you like to see in a park?
공원에서 너라면 무엇을 보고 싶어?
ex: I would like to see a little bird sitting in its nest.
나는 둥지에 앉아 있는 작은 새를 보고 싶어요.

s: Last Friday, Amy and her classmates gathered in the school kitchen to bake bread.
지난 금요일에 에이미와 반 친구들은 빵을 굽기 위해 학교 주방에 모였어요.
First, Amy mixed warm milk, sugar, and yeast in a big bowl.
먼저 에이미는 큰 그릇에 따뜻한 우유와 설탕과 이스트를 섞었어요.
Then Tom added flour and salt, because the recipe included both of them.
그다음에 톰은 밀가루와 소금을 넣었는데, 요리법에 둘 다 들어 있었기 때문이에요.
After that, Mina kept her bread plain, but Jiho put cheese on top.
그 뒤에 미나는 자기 빵에 아무것도 넣지 않았지만 지호는 위에 치즈를 올렸어요.
Finally, the teacher came to inspect the bread, and it smelled wonderful.
마지막으로 선생님이 빵을 살펴보러 오셨고, 빵에서는 좋은 냄새가 났어요.
Everyone ate a warm slice and thanked the teacher.
모두 따뜻한 빵 한 조각을 먹고 선생님께 감사 인사를 했어요.
ox: Amy's class made pizza at school last Friday.
에이미네 반은 지난 금요일 학교에서 피자를 만들었어요.
The teacher came to look at the bread.
선생님은 빵을 보러 오셨어요.
sm: Amy's class baked bread together, and everyone enjoyed it.
Amy burned the bread and left the kitchen.
Tom made soup, and nobody ate it.
q: What would you put on your bread?
너라면 빵에 뭘 올릴래?
ex: I would keep my bread plain and eat it with butter.
나는 빵에 아무것도 넣지 않고 버터와 함께 먹을 거예요.

s: Last summer, Jiho's family drove to an observatory on a mountain.
지난여름 지호네 가족은 산 위에 있는 천문대로 차를 타고 갔어요.
First, Jiho sat outside and made a sketch of the round roof.
먼저 지호는 밖에 앉아서 둥근 지붕을 스케치했어요.
Then he followed a green arrow on the floor, but soon he felt lost.
그다음에 그는 바닥의 초록색 화살표를 따라갔지만 곧 길을 잃은 기분이 들었어요.
After that, a kind guide helped him find his family near the main door.
그 뒤에 친절한 안내원이 지호가 정문 근처에서 가족을 찾도록 도와주었어요.
Finally, they looked through a big telescope at stars far beyond the clouds.
마지막으로 그들은 큰 망원경으로 구름 너머 멀리 있는 별들을 보았어요.
On the way home, Jiho was so tired that he fell asleep in the car.
집으로 돌아오는 길에 지호는 너무 피곤해서 차 안에서 잠들었어요.
ox: Jiho visited the observatory in winter.
지호는 겨울에 천문대를 방문했어요.
A guide helped Jiho find his family.
안내원이 지호가 가족을 찾도록 도와주었어요.
sm: Jiho visited an observatory, felt lost for a while, and then saw stars with his family.
Jiho stayed home and drew a picture of a dog.
The guide closed the observatory because of rain.
q: What would you like to see through a telescope?
망원경으로 뭘 보고 싶어?
ex: I would like to see the moon from an observatory.
나는 천문대에서 달을 보고 싶어요.

s: Last week, Minsu and Yuna made a poster about Mars for science class.
지난주에 민수와 유나는 과학 시간에 쓸 화성 포스터를 만들었어요.
First, they used the school's new technology to find photos of the red planet.
먼저 두 사람은 학교의 새로운 기술을 이용해 붉은 행성 사진을 찾았어요.
Then they tried to estimate how long a trip to Mars would take.
그다음에 두 사람은 화성까지 가는 데 얼마나 걸릴지 어림잡아 보려고 했어요.
After that, Yuna wrote the number on the poster, and Minsu drew a small rocket.
그 뒤에 유나는 포스터에 숫자를 적었고, 민수는 작은 로켓을 그렸어요.
Finally, they showed the poster to the class, and everyone thought the idea was exciting.
마지막으로 두 사람은 반 친구들에게 포스터를 보여 줬고, 모두 그 생각이 흥미진진하다고 여겼어요.
Their teacher smiled and said, "Good work, both of you!"
선생님은 웃으며 "둘 다 잘했어요!"라고 말씀하셨어요.
ox: Minsu and Yuna made a poster about the moon.
민수와 유나는 달에 대한 포스터를 만들었어요.
Everyone in the class thought the idea was exciting.
반 친구들 모두 그 생각이 흥미진진하다고 여겼어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Zoo
sm: Minsu and Yuna made a poster about Mars and showed it to the class.
Minsu forgot his poster and missed science class.
Yuna and Tom flew to Mars in a rocket.
q: What would you like to learn about space?
우주에 대해 뭘 배우고 싶어?
ex: I want to learn how technology can take people to Mars.
나는 기술로 사람들이 어떻게 화성에 갈 수 있는지 배우고 싶어요.

s: Last Saturday, Amy and her mother went to a small shop near the park.
지난 토요일에 에이미와 엄마는 공원 근처의 작은 가게에 갔어요.
First, Amy found a pair of blue jeans, but they were too long.
먼저 에이미는 파란 청바지 한 벌을 찾았는데, 너무 길었어요.
Then the clerk gladly said the shop could shorten them by Monday.
그다음에 점원이 월요일까지 기꺼이 줄여 주겠다고 말했어요.
After that, Amy asked for home delivery, and the clerk wrote down her address.
그 뒤에 에이미는 집으로 배달을 부탁했고, 점원은 에이미의 주소를 적었어요.
Finally, Amy bought a magazine about dogs and read it on a bench in the park.
마지막으로 에이미는 강아지에 관한 잡지를 사서 공원 벤치에서 읽었어요.
Her mother smiled and said, "That was a good shopping day!"
엄마는 웃으며 "좋은 쇼핑 날이었어!"라고 말했어요.
ox: Amy's jeans were too short.
에이미의 청바지는 너무 짧았어요.
Amy asked the shop to send the jeans to her home.
에이미는 가게에 청바지를 집으로 보내 달라고 부탁했어요.
tc: A Cold Day at the Lake
sm: Amy bought jeans and a magazine, and the shop would send the jeans to her home.
Amy lost her jeans at the park and went home.
Amy's mother bought a magazine and a new bike.
q: What would you buy at a small shop?
작은 가게에서 너라면 뭘 사겠어?
ex: I would buy a magazine about space and read it at home.
나는 우주에 관한 잡지를 사서 집에서 읽을 거예요.

s: Last Friday, a famous author visited Minsu's school to talk about her new story book.
지난 금요일에 유명한 작가가 민수의 학교를 찾아와 새로 쓴 이야기책에 대해 이야기했어요.
First, Minsu was curious about how she found ideas, so he raised his hand.
먼저 민수는 작가가 어떻게 아이디어를 찾는지 궁금해서 손을 들었어요.
Then the author smiled and said that she watched small things around her every day.
그다음에 작가는 웃으며 매일 주변의 작은 것들을 살펴본다고 말했어요.
After that, Yuna and Jiho showed good teamwork and made a big poster of the story.
그 뒤에 유나와 지호는 훌륭한 팀워크를 보여 주며 이야기를 담은 큰 포스터를 만들었어요.
Finally, the poster impressed the author, and she signed it for the class.
마지막으로 그 포스터가 작가에게 깊은 인상을 주었고, 작가는 반을 위해 사인을 해 주었어요.
Minsu felt happy because he learned that everyone can write a story.
민수는 누구나 이야기를 쓸 수 있다는 것을 배워서 기뻤어요.
ox: The author did not like the poster.
작가는 그 포스터를 마음에 들어 하지 않았어요.
Yuna and Jiho made a poster together.
유나와 지호는 함께 포스터를 만들었어요.
sm: An author visited Minsu's school, and the class made a poster that she liked.
Minsu forgot his book, and the author went home early.
Yuna wrote a story alone and won a prize.
q: What would you ask a famous author?
유명한 작가에게 무엇을 묻고 싶어요?
ex: I would ask the author to read her story to our class.
나는 작가님께 우리 반에게 이야기를 읽어 달라고 부탁할 거예요.

s: Last Saturday, Amy and her father went to a summer carnival in the town park.
지난 토요일에 에이미와 아버지는 마을 공원에서 열린 여름 축제에 갔어요.
First, Amy's father made the payment at the ticket booth, and they went inside.
먼저 에이미의 아버지가 매표소에서 결제를 했고, 두 사람은 안으로 들어갔어요.
Then they got on a tall wheel, and it slowly ascended above the park.
그다음에 두 사람은 높은 바퀴 놀이기구를 탔고, 그것은 공원 위로 천천히 올라갔어요.
After that, Amy gazed at the colorful lights of the town from the top.
그 뒤에 에이미는 꼭대기에서 마을의 알록달록한 불빛을 바라보았어요.
Finally, they ate warm corn, played two games, and walked back to the car.
마지막으로 두 사람은 따뜻한 옥수수를 먹고 게임을 두 번 한 뒤 걸어서 차로 돌아갔어요.
Amy said it was the best weekend of her summer.
에이미는 이번 여름 중 가장 좋은 주말이었다고 말했어요.
t: A Day at the Summer Carnival
ox: Amy went to the carnival with her teacher.
에이미는 선생님과 함께 축제에 갔어요.
Amy saw the lights of the town from the top.
에이미는 꼭대기에서 마을의 불빛을 보았어요.
tc: A Day at the Summer Carnival
sm: Amy and her father went to a carnival, rode a tall wheel, and had a great day.
Amy missed the carnival because it rained all day.
Amy's father lost the tickets, so they went home.
q: What would you do at a carnival?
축제에 가면 무엇을 하고 싶어요?
ex: I would try every game at the carnival and gaze at the lights.
나는 축제에서 모든 게임을 해 보고 불빛을 바라볼 거예요.

s: Last month, Mina did research on soil for her science report at school.
지난달 미나는 학교 과학 보고서를 쓰려고 흙에 대해 조사했어요.
First, she used a simple method to see which soil can absorb the most water.
먼저 미나는 어떤 흙이 물을 가장 많이 흡수하는지 보려고 간단한 방법을 썼어요.
Then she took three samples from the school garden and put them in cups.
그다음에 미나는 학교 정원에서 흙 견본 세 개를 가져와 컵에 담았어요.
After that, she needed patience, because the water went down slowly.
그 뒤에 물이 천천히 내려가서 미나는 인내심이 필요했어요.
Finally, she wrote her results and showed them to the class.
마지막으로 미나는 결과를 써서 반 친구들에게 보여 줬어요.
Her classmates clapped, and Tom asked her many questions.
반 친구들이 박수를 쳤고, 톰은 미나에게 질문을 많이 했어요.
ox: Mina wrote her report about animals.
미나는 동물에 대한 보고서를 썼어요.
Mina needed patience because the water went down slowly.
물이 천천히 내려가서 미나는 인내심이 필요했어요.
tc: A Windy Day at the Beach
sm: Mina tested soil with a simple method and showed her results to the class.
Mina lost her cups and stopped her report.
Tom did the whole test while Mina watched.
q: What would you test for a science report?
과학 보고서를 쓴다면 너는 무엇을 실험해 볼래?
ex: I would use a simple method to test which cloth dries fastest.
나는 어떤 천이 가장 빨리 마르는지 간단한 방법으로 실험해 볼 거예요.

s: Last summer, Amy's family had an opportunity to visit a small village by the sea.
지난여름 에이미네 가족은 바닷가의 작은 마을을 방문할 기회가 있었어요.
First, each person got a big portion of noodles at the market.
먼저 모두가 시장에서 국수를 푸짐하게 한 그릇씩 받았어요.
Then Dad used a small camp stove to boil water for tea.
그다음에 아빠는 작은 캠핑용 버너로 차를 마시려고 물을 끓이셨어요.
After that, they walked along the beach and watched the sun go down.
그 뒤에 가족은 해변을 따라 걸으며 해가 지는 것을 지켜봤어요.
Finally, Amy sent a message to her grandmother with a photo of the sunset.
마지막으로 에이미는 할머니께 노을 사진과 함께 메시지를 보냈어요.
Her grandmother wrote back and said it was a lovely trip.
할머니는 답장을 보내 정말 멋진 여행이라고 말씀하셨어요.
t: A Summer Trip to the Sea
ox: Amy's family visited a big city.
에이미네 가족은 큰 도시를 방문했어요.
Amy sent a message to her grandmother.
에이미는 할머니께 메시지를 보냈어요.
tc: A Summer Trip to the Sea
sm: Amy's family visited a village by the sea, ate noodles, walked on the beach, and sent a message.
Amy's family stayed home and cooked all day.
Amy lost her phone at the market and could not call.
q: Which place would you like to visit with your family?
가족과 함께 어디에 가 보고 싶어?
ex: If I have an opportunity, I would visit the sea with my family.
기회가 생기면 나는 가족과 함께 바다에 가고 싶어요.

s: Last week, the student council planned a poster contest about recycling at our school.
지난주에 학생회는 우리 학교에서 재활용에 대한 포스터 대회를 계획했어요.
First, Mina asked the teacher for specific rules, because the contest was important to her.
먼저 미나는 대회가 자신에게 중요했기 때문에 선생님께 구체적인 규칙을 여쭤봤어요.
Then a worker came to deliver colorful pens and glue to the art room.
그다음에 직원 한 분이 미술실에 알록달록한 펜과 풀을 배달하러 왔어요.
After that, she and Jiho drew bottles, cans, and paper on a large poster.
그 뒤에 미나와 지호는 큰 포스터에 병과 캔과 종이를 그렸어요.
Finally, the council gave every student a shiny sticker, and Mina's poster won first prize.
마지막으로 학생회는 모든 학생에게 반짝이는 스티커를 하나씩 주었고, 미나의 포스터가 1등을 했어요.
Mina smiled and thanked Jiho for his hard work.
미나는 웃으며 지호의 노력에 고마워했어요.
ox: The council planned a music concert.
학생회는 음악회를 계획했어요.
Jiho helped Mina draw the poster.
지호는 미나가 포스터 그리는 것을 도왔어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Zoo
sm: Mina made a recycling poster with Jiho and won a prize at school.
Mina lost her pens and left the contest early.
The teacher stopped the contest because of rain.
q: What would you draw on a recycling poster?
재활용 포스터에 너라면 뭘 그릴래?
ex: I would draw a big bottle and write an important message.
나는 큰 병을 그리고 중요한 메시지를 쓸 거예요.

s: Last Sunday, Amy and her father walked one mile to a quiet lake near their town.
지난 일요일에 에이미와 아버지는 동네 근처의 조용한 호수까지 1마일을 걸어갔어요.
First, they found a peaceful bench under the trees and watched the ducks.
먼저 두 사람은 나무 아래에서 평화로운 벤치를 찾아 오리들을 구경했어요.
Then a foreigner asked them how to get to a cafe near the park.
그다음에 한 외국인이 공원 근처 카페에 가는 방법을 두 사람에게 물었어요.
After that, Amy remembered that she had left her wallet somewhere on the path.
그 뒤에 에이미는 길 어딘가에 지갑을 두고 왔다는 것이 떠올랐어요.
Finally, they found it near the bench, and her father bought her a waffle at the cafe.
마지막으로 두 사람은 벤치 근처에서 지갑을 찾았고, 아버지는 카페에서 에이미에게 와플을 사 주셨어요.
They took the bus home and talked about the day.
두 사람은 버스를 타고 집에 와서 그날 일에 대해 이야기했어요.
t: A Quiet Day at the Lake
ox: Amy and her father took the bus to the lake.
에이미와 아버지는 버스를 타고 호수에 갔어요.
Amy found her wallet again.
에이미는 지갑을 다시 찾았어요.
tc: A Quiet Day at the Lake
A Funny Day at the Pool
sm: Amy and her father enjoyed a quiet lake, found a lost wallet, and ate a waffle.
Amy missed the bus and went home hungry.
Amy's father lost his phone at the cafe.
q: Where would you go for a peaceful walk?
평화롭게 산책하려면 어디에 갈래?
ex: I would go to a quiet park and walk one mile with my dog.
나는 조용한 공원에 가서 강아지와 1마일을 걸을 거예요.

s: Last Tuesday, Mina joined a study session after school for her hardest subject, English.
지난 화요일에 미나는 가장 어려운 과목인 영어를 공부하려고 방과 후 학습 시간에 참여했어요.
First, the teacher showed her an effective trick: guess a new word from its context.
먼저 선생님은 미나에게 새 단어를 문맥에서 짐작해 보는 효과적인 요령을 알려 주셨어요.
Then Mina and Tom read a short story and circled every word they did not know.
그다음에 미나와 톰은 짧은 이야기를 읽고 모르는 단어마다 동그라미를 쳤어요.
After that, they guessed each meaning from the sentences around it and wrote their ideas down.
그 뒤에 두 사람은 주변 문장들을 보고 각 뜻을 짐작해서 생각을 적었어요.
Finally, the teacher checked their notes and said that most of the guesses were correct.
마지막으로 선생님은 두 사람의 공책을 확인하고 대부분의 짐작이 맞았다고 말씀하셨어요.
Eventually, Mina felt much more confident about reading English stories on her own.
결국 미나는 영어 이야기를 혼자 읽는 데 훨씬 더 자신감이 생겼어요.
ox: Mina studied math in the session.
미나는 학습 시간에 수학을 공부했어요.
Tom read a story with Mina.
톰은 미나와 함께 이야기를 읽었어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Zoo
sm: Mina learned a way to guess new words and felt more confident.
Mina lost her notebook and missed the class.
Tom taught Mina to play the piano.
q: How do you learn new words best?

sm: Tom and Jiho rode to a park fair, tried an instrument, and went home happy.
Tom lost his bike and could not find the park.
Jiho bought a new bike at the fair.
q: Which instrument would you like to try?
어떤 악기를 체험해 보고 싶어?
ex: I would like to learn a new instrument, maybe the violin.
나는 새 악기를 배우고 싶어요, 아마 바이올린이요.

s: Last term, Tom made it his aim to read twenty books before winter vacation.
지난 학기에 톰은 겨울 방학 전에 책 스무 권을 읽는 것을 목표로 삼았어요.
First, a classmate gave him a useful tip about reading ten pages every night.
먼저 반 친구가 매일 밤 열 쪽씩 읽으라는 유용한 요령을 알려 주었어요.
Then he asked a peer in his class to read the same book with him.
그다음에 톰은 같은 반 또래에게 같은 책을 함께 읽자고 부탁했어요.
After that, the two of them talked about the story every Friday at lunch.
그 뒤에 두 사람은 금요일마다 점심시간에 그 이야기를 두고 대화를 나눴어요.
Finally, Tom saw clear progress, and he finished twenty-two books.
마지막으로 톰은 뚜렷한 발전을 확인했고 책 스물두 권을 다 읽었어요.
His teacher was proud, and she put his name on the reading board.
선생님은 자랑스러워하셨고 독서 게시판에 톰의 이름을 붙여 주셨어요.
ox: Tom read only five books before winter vacation.
톰은 겨울 방학 전에 책을 다섯 권만 읽었어요.
Tom talked about the story with a classmate every Friday.
톰은 금요일마다 반 친구와 그 이야기를 두고 대화를 나눴어요.
tc: A Cold Day at the Zoo
sm: Tom set a reading goal, got help from a classmate, and reached it.
Tom lost his book and stopped reading.
Tom's teacher gave him a very hard test.
q: What is your goal for this year?
올해 너의 목표는 뭐야?
ex: My aim is to learn ten new English words every week.
내 목표는 매주 새 영어 단어를 열 개씩 배우는 거예요.

s: Last summer, Amy's family took an overseas trip to visit her aunt in Taiwan.
지난여름 에이미네 가족은 이모를 만나러 대만으로 해외여행을 갔어요.
First, their plane departed from Incheon early in the morning.
먼저 그들의 비행기는 이른 아침에 인천에서 출발했어요.
Then they visited a busy night market, where every shopper was looking for snacks.
그다음에 그들은 붐비는 야시장에 갔는데, 쇼핑객마다 간식을 찾고 있었어요.
After that, Amy exchanged some Korean money for local money at a small booth.
그 뒤에 에이미는 작은 가게에서 한국 돈 얼마를 현지 돈으로 바꿨어요.
Finally, the owner of a snack stall gave them kind and helpful service.
마지막으로 간식 가게 주인이 그들에게 친절하고 도움이 되는 서비스를 해 주었어요.
Amy bought a small gift for her friend and wrote about the day.
에이미는 친구에게 줄 작은 선물을 사고 그날에 대해 글을 썼어요.
t: A Trip to the Night Market
ox: Amy's plane left in the evening.
에이미의 비행기는 저녁에 떠났어요.
Amy changed some money at a small booth.
에이미는 작은 가게에서 돈을 조금 바꿨어요.
tc: A Trip to the Night Market
sm: Amy's family flew to another country, visited a market, and had a nice day.
Amy missed her plane and stayed at the airport all day.
Amy's aunt cooked dinner for the whole class.
q: What would you buy at a night market?
야시장에서 너라면 뭘 사겠어?
ex: I would exchange some money and buy a gift for my friend.
나는 돈을 조금 바꾸고 친구에게 줄 선물을 살 거예요.

s: Last Monday, Minsu took a spelling test, and he made a mistake on the last word.
지난 월요일에 민수는 철자 시험을 봤는데, 마지막 단어에서 실수를 했어요.
First, he wanted to hide the paper, but he remembered that honesty is important.
먼저 민수는 시험지를 숨기고 싶었지만, 정직이 중요하다는 것을 떠올렸어요.
Then he showed the test to his teacher and asked a question about the word.
그다음에 민수는 선생님께 시험지를 보여 드리고 그 단어에 대해 질문했어요.
After that, she helped him underline the hard letters with a green pen.
그 뒤에 선생님은 민수가 어려운 글자에 초록색 펜으로 밑줄을 긋도록 도와주셨어요.
Finally, Minsu practiced the word five times, and he spelled it correctly.
마지막으로 민수는 그 단어를 다섯 번 연습했고, 맞게 쓸 수 있었어요.
The teacher smiled and said that Minsu was brave.
선생님은 웃으며 민수가 용감했다고 말씀하셨어요.
ox: Minsu got every word right on the test.
민수는 시험에서 모든 단어를 맞혔어요.
Minsu asked his teacher a question about the word.
민수는 선생님께 그 단어에 대해 질문했어요.
sm: Minsu made a mistake on a test, told his teacher, and learned the word.
Minsu hid his test and never studied the word again.
Minsu's teacher gave him a new pen and a long break.
q: What would you do if you made a mistake on a test?
시험에서 실수를 하면 너라면 어떻게 할래?
ex: I would tell my teacher the truth and ask a question.
나라면 선생님께 사실대로 말씀드리고 질문할 거예요.

s: Last Saturday, it rained all morning, so Amy's family took a big umbrella to the farm.
지난 토요일에 아침 내내 비가 와서 에이미네 가족은 큰 우산을 가지고 농장에 갔어요.
First, the yard near the barn was muddy, so everyone walked slowly.
먼저 헛간 근처 마당이 질척해서 모두 천천히 걸었어요.
Then they saw a small lamb drinking milk next to its mother.
그다음에 가족은 어미 곁에서 우유를 먹는 작은 새끼 양을 봤어요.
After that, water began to leak through the barn roof, so the farmer moved the animals.
그 뒤에 헛간 지붕으로 물이 새기 시작해서 농부 아저씨가 동물들을 옮겼어요.
Finally, Amy wanted a toy lamb from the shop, and Dad said they could afford it.
마지막으로 에이미는 가게에서 장난감 양을 갖고 싶어 했고, 아빠는 살 여유가 된다고 말씀하셨어요.
On the bus home, Amy held her new toy and smiled.
집에 오는 버스에서 에이미는 새 장난감을 안고 웃었어요.
t: A Rainy Day at the Farm
ox: The family went to the farm on a sunny day.
가족은 해가 쨍쨍한 날 농장에 갔어요.
A small lamb was drinking milk next to its mother.
작은 새끼 양이 어미 곁에서 우유를 먹고 있었어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Farm
sm: Amy's family visited a farm in the rain, saw a lamb, and bought a toy.
Amy's family stayed home and watched TV all day.
Amy lost her umbrella and could not find the farm.
q: What animal would you like to see at a farm?
농장에서 어떤 동물을 보고 싶어?
ex: I would like to see a lamb because it is soft and small.
나는 부드럽고 작은 새끼 양을 보고 싶어요.

s: Last Monday, an announcement told students about a drawing workshop after school.
지난 월요일에 안내 방송이 학생들에게 방과 후 그림 워크숍에 대해 알려 주었어요.
First, Mina and Tom drew a friendly bear with a large amount of yellow paint.
먼저 미나와 톰은 많은 양의 노란 물감으로 친근한 곰을 그렸어요.
Then Jiho found the courage to show his rabbit picture to the whole class.
그다음에 지호는 용기를 내어 자기 토끼 그림을 반 전체에 보여 주었어요.
After that, everyone voted, and the teacher counted all the small papers.
그 뒤에 모두가 투표했고, 선생님은 작은 종이들을 전부 세었어요.
Finally, the class chose Mina's bear as the new school mascot.
마지막으로 반 친구들은 미나의 곰을 새 학교 마스코트로 뽑았어요.
Mina smiled and thanked her friends for their help.
미나는 웃으며 도와준 친구들에게 고마워했어요.
ox: The class chose Jiho's rabbit as the new mascot.
반 친구들은 지호의 토끼를 새 마스코트로 뽑았어요.
Mina and Tom drew a bear together.
미나와 톰은 함께 곰을 그렸어요.
tc: A Hot Day at the Beach
sm: Students drew pictures after school, voted, and chose Mina's bear as the mascot.
The teacher forgot the workshop, so the students went home early.
Jiho painted a large rabbit and won a prize at the park.
q: What animal would you choose for a school mascot?
학교 마스코트로 어떤 동물을 고를래?
ex: I would choose a dolphin as our mascot because it is smart and friendly.
나는 돌고래가 똑똑하고 친근해서 우리 마스코트로 고를 거예요.

s: Last summer, Amy's family drove to a lake surrounded by tall pine trees.
지난여름 에이미네 가족은 키 큰 소나무에 둘러싸인 호수로 차를 타고 갔어요.
First, they walked along the shore and saw a white crane standing in the water.
먼저 그들은 물가를 따라 걷다가 물속에 서 있는 흰 두루미를 보았어요.
Then everyone became silent because they did not want to scare the bird.
그다음에 모두가 새를 놀라게 하고 싶지 않아서 조용해졌어요.
After that, Amy took a photo, and the lake looked stunning in the morning light.
그 뒤에 에이미는 사진을 찍었고, 호수는 아침 햇살 속에서 정말 멋져 보였어요.
Finally, they ate sandwiches on a big rock and watched the bird fly away.
마지막으로 가족은 큰 바위 위에서 샌드위치를 먹고 새가 날아가는 것을 지켜보았어요.
On the drive home, Amy showed the photo to her little brother.
집에 오는 차 안에서 에이미는 어린 남동생에게 사진을 보여 주었어요.
t: A Quiet Morning at the Lake
ox: Amy's family went to the lake in winter.
에이미네 가족은 겨울에 호수에 갔어요.
The family stayed quiet so the bird would not be scared.
가족은 새가 놀라지 않도록 조용히 있었어요.
tc: A Quiet Morning at the Lake
A Busy Day at the Market
sm: Amy's family saw a white bird at a lake, stayed quiet, and took a photo.
Amy lost her photo at the lake and went home in tears.
The family left the lake early because the bird made a loud noise.
q: What would you do if you saw a wild bird at a lake?
호수에서 야생 새를 본다면 너라면 어떻게 할래?
ex: I would stay silent and take a stunning photo of it.
나는 조용히 있으면서 그 새의 멋진 사진을 찍을 거예요.

s: Last Monday, Mina joined the school writing club because she wanted to write a fiction story.
지난 월요일 미나는 소설을 쓰고 싶어서 학교 글쓰기 동아리에 들어갔어요.
First, she wrote one good phrase, "a tiny silver key," on the first page.
먼저 미나는 첫 페이지에 "작은 은색 열쇠"라는 멋진 표현을 하나 썼어요.
Then she showed her story to Tom and asked him for feedback.
그다음에 미나는 톰에게 이야기를 보여 주고 의견을 부탁했어요.
After that, she considered his ideas and wrote a new version of the ending.
그 뒤에 미나는 톰의 생각을 고려해서 결말의 새 버전을 썼어요.
Finally, the club teacher read it aloud, and everyone clapped.
마지막으로 동아리 선생님이 그 글을 소리 내어 읽으셨고 모두 박수를 쳤어요.
Mina smiled and promised to bring another story next week.
미나는 웃으면서 다음 주에 다른 이야기를 가져오겠다고 약속했어요.
ox: Mina joined the art club last Monday.
미나는 지난 월요일에 미술 동아리에 들어갔어요.
Mina asked Tom for feedback on her story.
미나는 톰에게 자기 이야기에 대한 의견을 부탁했어요.
tc: A Busy Day at the Market
sm: Mina joined a writing club, got feedback, and made her story better.
Mina lost her notebook and left the club.
Tom wrote a story and gave Mina a prize.
q: What kind of story would you write?
너라면 어떤 이야기를 쓸래?
ex: I would write a fiction story about a trip to space.
나는 우주 여행에 관한 소설을 쓸 거예요.

s: Last Saturday, Jiho saved enough of his allowance to visit a park with his cousin Yuna.
지난 토요일 지호는 용돈을 충분히 모아서 사촌 유나와 함께 공원에 갔어요.
First, he paid the bus fare, and they rode for thirty minutes.
먼저 지호가 버스 요금을 냈고 둘은 30분 동안 버스를 탔어요.
Then they saw a stone monument near the lake and took photos of it.
그다음에 둘은 호수 근처에서 돌 기념물을 보고 사진을 찍었어요.
After that, they watched a big turtle swim slowly under the bridge.
그 뒤에 둘은 커다란 거북이 다리 아래에서 천천히 헤엄치는 것을 구경했어요.
Finally, they bought two ice creams, and Yuna said the trip was worth the money.
마지막으로 둘은 아이스크림 두 개를 샀고, 유나는 이번 여행이 돈이 아깝지 않다고 말했어요.
They rode the bus home and told their parents about the turtle.
둘은 버스를 타고 집에 와서 부모님께 거북 이야기를 해 드렸어요.
ox: Jiho and Yuna went to the park by taxi.
지호와 유나는 택시를 타고 공원에 갔어요.
Jiho and Yuna watched a turtle under the bridge.
지호와 유나는 다리 아래에서 거북을 구경했어요.
sm: Jiho and Yuna took a bus to a park, saw interesting things, and enjoyed the trip.
Jiho lost his money and went home early.
Yuna bought a turtle and took it home.
q: Where would you go with your allowance?
용돈으로 어디에 가고 싶어?
ex: I would go to a park and watch the turtles.
나는 공원에 가서 거북을 구경하고 싶어요.

s: Last Friday, Jiho's class made vegetable soup in the school kitchen.
지난 금요일에 지호네 반은 학교 주방에서 채소 수프를 만들었어요.
First, the teacher gave each group a basket with every ingredient they needed.
먼저 선생님이 각 모둠에 필요한 재료가 모두 든 바구니를 나눠 주셨어요.
Then Amy cut the crisp carrots, and Jiho began to stir the pot.
그다음에 에이미는 아삭한 당근을 썰었고, 지호는 냄비를 젓기 시작했어요.
After that, the soup smelled so good that the whole room became quiet.
그 뒤에 수프 냄새가 너무 좋아서 교실 전체가 조용해졌어요.
Finally, Tom said they were lucky because their group finished before the others.
마지막으로 톰은 다른 모둠보다 먼저 끝내서 자기들이 운이 좋았다고 말했어요.
Everyone ate a full bowl, and the teacher gave them a high score.
모두 한 그릇 가득 먹었고, 선생님은 아이들에게 높은 점수를 주셨어요.
ox: Jiho's class made fruit juice in the park.
지호네 반은 공원에서 과일 주스를 만들었어요.
Amy cut carrots for the soup.
에이미는 수프에 넣을 당근을 썰었어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Zoo
sm: Jiho's class cooked soup together, finished early, and got a high score.
The soup burned, so the class had to start again.
Amy and Tom lost their basket and went home early.
q: What would you cook with your friends?
친구들과 함께 무엇을 요리하고 싶어요?
ex: I would cook noodles with fresh ingredients and stir them well.
나는 신선한 재료로 국수를 요리하고 잘 저을 거예요.

s: Last month, Mina's family stayed at a mountain resort for two nights.
지난달에 미나네 가족은 산속 휴양지에서 이틀 밤을 묵었어요.
First, they walked up a trail, and a small lake appeared below the hill.
먼저 가족은 산길을 올라갔고, 언덕 아래로 작은 호수가 나타났어요.
Then Mina sat by the water and listened to a musician play the guitar.
그다음에 미나는 물가에 앉아 한 음악가가 기타를 치는 소리를 들었어요.
After that, her little brother asked the man how he learned to play so well.
그 뒤에 미나의 남동생은 그 아저씨에게 어떻게 그렇게 잘 치게 되었는지 물었어요.
Finally, the man smiled and said that music gave him great pleasure.
마지막으로 아저씨는 웃으며 음악이 자신에게 큰 기쁨을 준다고 말했어요.
On the ride home, Mina's family talked about the beautiful trip.
집에 돌아오는 길에 미나네 가족은 아름다웠던 여행에 대해 이야기했어요.
t: A Weekend at the Mountain Resort
ox: Mina's family stayed at the resort for a week.
미나네 가족은 일주일 동안 휴양지에 묵었어요.
Mina listened to a musician play the guitar.
미나는 한 음악가가 기타를 치는 소리를 들었어요.
tc: A Weekend at the Mountain Resort
sm: Mina's family enjoyed a resort trip with a lake walk and a guitar player.
Mina's family lost their way and went home early.
Mina learned to play the guitar in a music class.
q: Which do you like better, a lake walk or a quiet beach?
호숫가 산책과 조용한 해변 중 어느 쪽이 더 좋아요?
ex: I would stay at a beach resort and swim every morning.
나는 해변 휴양지에 묵으면서 매일 아침 수영할 거예요.

s: Last Tuesday, Minsu's class visited City Hall to learn how a city works.
지난 화요일에 민수네 반은 도시가 어떻게 운영되는지 배우러 시청을 방문했어요.
First, a guide led the students to a room where the mayor answered questions.
먼저 안내원이 학생들을 시장님이 질문에 답해 주는 방으로 데려갔어요.
Then Yuna raised her hand, and the mayor gave her a positive answer about a new park.
그다음에 유나가 손을 들었고, 시장님은 새 공원에 대해 긍정적인 답을 주셨어요.
After that, a diligent worker showed them a map and a traffic signal on a screen.
그 뒤에 부지런한 직원이 화면으로 지도와 신호등을 보여 주었어요.
Finally, Minsu wrote a short report, and the class thanked the guide.
마지막으로 민수는 짧은 보고서를 썼고, 반 친구들은 안내원에게 고맙다고 인사했어요.
On the bus ride home, everyone felt happy and proud of what they learned.
집에 돌아가는 버스에서 모두 배운 것이 뿌듯하고 즐거웠어요.
ox: The students visited City Hall on Sunday.
학생들은 일요일에 시청을 방문했어요.
Yuna asked a question, and the mayor answered it.
유나가 질문을 했고 시장님이 답해 주었어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Zoo
sm: Minsu's class visited City Hall, met the mayor, and learned about the city.
The class missed the bus and could not enter the building.
Yuna was upset because the guide did not answer any questions.
q: What would you ask a mayor if you met one?
시장님을 만나면 무엇을 물어볼래?
ex: I would ask the mayor to build a bigger park for children.
나는 시장님께 어린이를 위한 더 큰 공원을 지어 달라고 부탁할 거예요.

s: Last summer, Jiho and Tom went to a farm with their uncle.
지난여름에 지호와 톰은 삼촌과 함께 농장에 갔어요.
First, they saw a big herd of cows walking slowly toward the barn.
먼저 아이들은 소 떼가 헛간 쪽으로 천천히 걸어가는 것을 보았어요.
Then Tom found a green larva under a leaf, and Jiho took a picture of it.
그다음에 톰이 잎 아래에서 초록색 애벌레를 발견했고, 지호는 그것을 사진으로 찍었어요.
After that, the boys helped their uncle lift heavy bags of corn onto a truck.
그 뒤에 두 아이는 삼촌이 무거운 옥수수 자루를 트럭에 싣는 것을 도왔어요.
Finally, it began to rain, so they quickly ran inside the farmhouse.
마지막으로 비가 오기 시작해서 아이들은 재빨리 농가 안으로 뛰어갔어요.
They drank warm milk there and talked about the day until dinner.
아이들은 그곳에서 따뜻한 우유를 마시며 저녁 식사 때까지 그날 이야기를 나눴어요.
ox: Tom and Jiho went to the farm alone.
톰과 지호는 혼자서 농장에 갔어요.
The boys helped their uncle with heavy bags.
두 아이는 삼촌의 무거운 자루를 도왔어요.
sm: Two boys visited a farm, helped their uncle, and ran inside when it rained.
Tom lost his bag and could not find the farm.
Jiho and Tom stayed home and played games all day.
q: What would you do if you spent a day on a farm?
농장에서 하루를 보낸다면 뭘 할래?
ex: I would lift buckets of water and feed the herd of cows.
나는 물통을 들어 나르고 소 떼에게 먹이를 줄 거예요.

s: Last month, Mina and Amy had a big school project about the environment.
지난달 미나와 에이미는 환경에 대한 큰 학교 과제를 했어요.
First, they chose a template from the computer and wrote a title.
먼저 두 사람은 컴퓨터에서 서식을 고르고 제목을 썼어요.
Then they took extra photos of old plastic bottles in the park near school.
그다음에 학교 근처 공원에서 낡은 플라스틱 병 사진을 더 많이 찍었어요.
After that, they added short sentences under each photo to explain the idea.
그 뒤에 두 사람은 생각을 설명하려고 사진마다 짧은 문장을 덧붙였어요.
Finally, they showed their poster to the class on Friday.
마지막으로 금요일에 반 친구들에게 포스터를 보여 주었어요.
Everyone clapped loudly, and the teacher said it was a great job.
모두가 크게 박수를 쳤고, 선생님은 아주 잘했다고 말씀하셨어요.
ox: The girls took photos of animals at the zoo.
두 소녀는 동물원에서 동물 사진을 찍었어요.
The girls showed their poster to the class.
두 소녀는 반 친구들에게 포스터를 보여 주었어요.
tc: A Lost Camera at the Zoo
sm: Two girls made a poster about the environment and showed it to their class.
The girls lost their photos and could not finish the poster.
Mina and Amy did the project at the beach with their parents.
q: What would you put on a poster about the environment?
환경에 대한 포스터에 너라면 무엇을 넣을래?
ex: I would use a template and add a photo of a clean river.
나라면 서식을 쓰고 깨끗한 강 사진을 넣을 거예요.

s: Last summer, Tom and his sibling visited a farm in a foreign country.
지난여름 톰과 그의 형제자매는 외국의 한 농장을 방문했어요.
First, the farmer greeted them with a friendly smile and a strong accent.
먼저 농부 아저씨는 다정한 미소와 강한 억양으로 두 사람을 맞이했어요.
Then Tom's sibling helped him translate the farmer's words into Korean.
그다음에 톰의 형제자매가 농부 아저씨의 말을 한국어로 번역하는 것을 도와줬어요.
After that, they joined the corn harvest in the fields for two hours.
그 뒤에 두 사람은 두 시간 동안 밭에서 옥수수 수확에 함께했어요.
Finally, the farmer gave them a basket of corn to take home.
마지막으로 농부 아저씨는 집에 가져갈 옥수수 한 바구니를 주셨어요.
On the flight back, Tom smiled and said it was a wonderful trip.
돌아오는 비행기에서 톰은 웃으며 멋진 여행이었다고 말했어요.
ox: Tom traveled to the farm alone.
톰은 혼자 농장에 갔어요.
Tom's sibling helped him understand the farmer.
톰의 형제자매는 톰이 농부 아저씨의 말을 이해하도록 도와줬어요.
tc: The Lost Bag at the Airport
sm: Tom and his sibling visited a farm abroad, picked corn, and enjoyed the trip.
Tom lost his bag at the airport and went straight home.
The farmer was angry and sent the children away.
q: Which country would you like to visit, and why?
어느 나라에 가 보고 싶어? 이유는 뭐야?
ex: I would go to a foreign country and learn to translate a few words.
나는 외국에 가서 몇 마디 말을 번역하는 법을 배우고 싶어요.

s: Last Tuesday, Minsu and Yuna did an experiment in their science class.
지난 화요일에 민수와 유나는 과학 시간에 실험을 했어요.
First, the teacher showed a basic picture of a water molecule on the board.
먼저 선생님이 칠판에 물 분자의 기본적인 그림을 보여 주셨어요.
Then they mixed salt into a cup of warm water and watched it carefully.
그다음에 두 사람은 따뜻한 물 한 컵에 소금을 섞고 조심스럽게 지켜봤어요.
After that, the salt disappeared, and Yuna wrote down what she saw.
그 뒤에 소금이 사라졌고, 유나는 자기가 본 것을 적었어요.
Finally, Minsu explained that the salt water was a solution made of two parts.
마지막으로 민수는 소금물이 두 가지로 이루어진 용액이라고 설명했어요.
Both students felt proud because they understood the idea so well.
두 학생은 그 내용을 아주 잘 이해해서 뿌듯했어요.
ox: Minsu and Yuna did the experiment at home.
민수와 유나는 집에서 실험을 했어요.
The salt disappeared in the warm water.
소금은 따뜻한 물속에서 사라졌어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Zoo
sm: Two students mixed salt and water in science class and learned from it.
The students forgot their cups and went home early.
Minsu and Yuna were angry because the teacher closed the class.
q: What would you mix with water in an experiment?
실험에서 물에 뭘 섞어 보고 싶어?
ex: I would mix sugar with water to make a sweet solution.
나는 설탕을 물에 섞어서 달콤한 용액을 만들어 볼 거예요.

s: Last Saturday, Amy and Tom rode their bikes to a big lake.
지난 토요일에 에이미와 톰은 자전거를 타고 큰 호수에 갔어요.
First, they went down a hill, and Tom pressed the brake to slow down.
먼저 두 사람은 언덕을 내려갔고, 톰은 속도를 줄이려고 브레이크를 눌렀어요.
Then they stopped at a high cliff and looked at the water below.
그다음에 두 사람은 높은 절벽에 멈춰서 아래의 물을 내려다봤어요.
After that, the weather made a rapid change, so they put on their jackets.
그 뒤에 날씨가 빠르게 바뀌어서 두 사람은 재킷을 입었어요.
Finally, they ate sandwiches on a bench and watched the ducks.
마지막으로 두 사람은 벤치에서 샌드위치를 먹으며 오리들을 구경했어요.
They rode home before dark, tired but happy with the whole day.
두 사람은 어두워지기 전에 자전거를 타고 집에 왔고, 피곤했지만 하루 전체가 행복했어요.
ox: Amy and Tom went to the lake by bus.
에이미와 톰은 버스를 타고 호수에 갔어요.
Tom slowed his bike on the hill.
톰은 언덕에서 자전거 속도를 줄였어요.
sm: Amy and Tom biked to a lake, saw a cliff, and had a nice day.
Amy and Tom stayed at school and cleaned the classroom all day.
Tom lost his bike, so they could not go to the lake.
q: Where would you go on a bike trip with friends?
친구들과 자전거 여행을 간다면 어디로 갈 거야?
ex: I would ride my bike to a lake and rest near the water.
나는 자전거를 타고 호수에 가서 물가에서 쉴 거예요.

s: Last month, Minsu sent an application to join the school science club.
지난달 민수는 학교 과학 동아리에 들어가려고 신청서를 보냈어요.
First, the club leader asked him to assist Yuna with a plant project.
먼저 동아리 부장이 민수에게 유나의 식물 프로젝트를 도와 달라고 부탁했어요.
Then they used a ruler and a simple tool to determine how tall the plant grew.
그다음에 두 사람은 자와 간단한 도구로 식물이 얼마나 자랐는지 알아냈어요.
After that, they wrote the numbers in a notebook every morning for two weeks.
그 뒤에 두 사람은 2주 동안 매일 아침 공책에 숫자를 적었어요.
Finally, the teacher said their project was a big success.
마지막으로 선생님은 두 사람의 프로젝트가 큰 성공이라고 말씀하셨어요.
Minsu felt proud, and he thanked Yuna for her help.
민수는 뿌듯했고, 유나의 도움에 고마워했어요.
ox: Minsu joined the art club last month.
민수는 지난달 미술 동아리에 들어갔어요.
The teacher thought the project was a success.
선생님은 그 프로젝트가 성공이라고 생각하셨어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Park
sm: Minsu joined the science club, measured a plant with Yuna, and did well.
Minsu forgot his form and missed the club.
Yuna grew a plant alone and lost the contest.
q: What would you grow in a science club?
과학 동아리에서 너라면 뭘 키워 볼래?
ex: I would grow beans and use a small tool to measure them.
나는 콩을 키우고 작은 도구로 재어 볼 거예요.

s: Last summer, Amy's family visited an old castle in the central part of the town.
지난여름 에이미네 가족은 마을 중심가에 있는 오래된 성을 방문했어요.
First, a guide told them that a lord lived there more than five hundred years ago.
먼저 안내원이 오백 년도 더 전에 영주가 그곳에 살았다고 알려 주었어요.
Then Amy learned that the lord's daughter was born in the tallest room.
그다음에 에이미는 영주의 딸이 가장 높은 방에서 태어났다는 것을 알게 되었어요.
After that, a sign warned visitors about the danger of the old stairs.
그 뒤에 표지판이 낡은 계단의 위험을 방문객들에게 경고했어요.
Finally, everyone agreed that the tour was very enjoyable.
마지막으로 모두가 그 견학이 아주 즐거웠다고 입을 모았어요.
On the bus home, Amy wrote about the castle in her notebook.
집에 돌아오는 버스에서 에이미는 공책에 성에 대해 적었어요.
t: A Trip to the Old Castle
ox: Amy visited the castle in winter.
에이미는 겨울에 성을 방문했어요.
A guide talked about a lord from long ago.
안내원이 아주 오래전의 영주에 대해 이야기했어요.
tc: A Trip to the Old Castle
A Funny Day at the Pool
sm: Amy's family toured an old castle, heard its story, and enjoyed the day.
Amy got lost inside the castle and could not find the bus.
The guide closed the castle because of a storm.
q: Which old place would you like to visit?
어떤 오래된 곳에 가 보고 싶어?
ex: I would visit an old castle and learn about the lord who lived there.
나는 오래된 성에 가서 그곳에 살았던 영주에 대해 배우고 싶어요.

s: Last week, Mina's class made a newspaper, and Tom wrote an article about soccer.
지난주에 미나네 반은 신문을 만들었고, 톰은 축구에 관한 기사를 썼어요.
First, Tom asked Amy to suggest a title for the front page.
먼저 톰은 에이미에게 첫 면에 쓸 제목을 제안해 달라고 부탁했어요.
Then Amy said that a photo was crucial, so Jiho took one at the field.
그다음에 에이미는 사진이 매우 중요하다고 말했고, 그래서 지호가 운동장에서 한 장을 찍었어요.
After that, the class printed the pages and put them on the board in the hall.
그 뒤에 반 친구들은 페이지를 인쇄해서 복도 게시판에 붙였어요.
Finally, the teacher read the article and wrote a kind comment at the bottom.
마지막으로 선생님은 기사를 읽고 맨 아래에 다정한 의견을 적어 주셨어요.
Everyone was happy, and Tom felt proud of his work.
모두가 기뻐했고, 톰은 자신이 한 일이 자랑스러웠어요.
ox: Tom wrote an article about music.
톰은 음악에 관한 기사를 썼어요.
The teacher wrote a comment on the newspaper.
선생님이 신문에 의견을 적어 주셨어요.
sm: Mina's class made a newspaper together, and the teacher liked it.
Tom lost the newspaper on the bus, and the class felt sad.
The class forgot to print the pages, so there was no newspaper.
q: What would you write about in a class newspaper?
반 신문에 너라면 무엇에 대해 쓸래?
ex: I would write an article about our school garden.
나는 우리 학교 정원에 대한 기사를 쓸 거예요.

s: Last Sunday, Yuna and her father went to a harbor market via the old bridge.
지난 일요일에 유나와 아빠는 옛 다리를 거쳐 항구 시장에 갔어요.
First, they smelled the sweet aroma of fresh bread from a small shop.
먼저 두 사람은 작은 가게에서 나는 갓 구운 빵의 달콤한 향기를 맡았어요.
Then Yuna took coins from her pocket and bought two loaves.
그다음에 유나는 주머니에서 동전을 꺼내 빵 두 덩이를 샀어요.
After that, a sign with an arrow indicated the way to the fruit stand.
그 뒤에 화살표가 그려진 표지판이 과일 가판대로 가는 길을 가리켰어요.
Finally, a worker put a label on each box, so Yuna could read the price.
마지막으로 일하는 분이 상자마다 라벨을 붙여서 유나는 가격을 읽을 수 있었어요.
They carried the fruit home and shared it at dinner.
두 사람은 과일을 집으로 가져가 저녁에 나눠 먹었어요.
t: A Trip to the Harbor Market
ox: Yuna went to the market alone.
유나는 혼자 시장에 갔어요.
A sign showed the way to the fruit stand.
표지판이 과일 가판대로 가는 길을 보여 줬어요.
tc: A Trip to the Harbor Market
sm: Yuna and her father visited a market, bought bread and fruit, and ate at home.
Yuna lost her money at the market and went home sad.
Yuna's father forgot the way, so they never reached the market.
q: What would you buy at a market?
시장에서 너라면 무엇을 살래?
ex: I would follow the aroma and buy fresh bread.
나는 향기를 따라가서 갓 구운 빵을 살 거예요.

s: Last month, Minsu and Mina joined a robot project in their science class at school.
지난달 민수와 미나는 학교 과학 시간에 로봇 프로젝트에 참여했어요.
First, they had difficulty because their small robot would not move across the table.
먼저 두 사람은 작은 로봇이 탁자 위에서 움직이지 않아서 어려움을 겪었어요.
Then they decided to persist, so they tried a new idea every afternoon.
그다음에 두 사람은 끈기 있게 계속하기로 해서 매일 오후 새로운 방법을 시도했어요.
After that, they combined a tiny motor with a plastic box from the lab.
그 뒤에 두 사람은 작은 모터를 실험실의 플라스틱 상자와 합쳤어요.
Finally, the robot rolled across the table, and everyone in the class clapped.
마침내 로봇이 탁자 위를 굴러갔고 반 친구들이 모두 박수를 쳤어요.
Their score was above average, and both students walked home with big smiles.
두 사람의 점수는 평균 이상이었고, 두 학생은 활짝 웃으며 집으로 걸어갔어요.
ox: Minsu and Mina built the robot in one day without any problem.
민수와 미나는 아무 문제 없이 하루 만에 로봇을 만들었어요.
The robot moved across the table at the end.
로봇은 마지막에 탁자 위를 움직였어요.
tc: A Rainy Day at the Zoo
sm: Two students tried again and again, and their robot finally worked.
The robot broke, so the two students gave up and went home.
Mina did the whole project alone and got a bad score.
q: What would you build for a science project?
과학 프로젝트로 뭘 만들어 보고 싶어?
ex: I would combine a small fan and a box to make a boat.
나는 작은 선풍기와 상자를 합쳐서 배를 만들 거예요.

s: Last Saturday, Tom and Amy went to a cleanup site near the river with their class.
지난 토요일에 톰과 에이미는 반 친구들과 함께 강 근처 청소 장소에 갔어요.
First, they saw old bottles and bags in the water and felt sad about the pollution.
먼저 아이들은 물속의 낡은 병과 봉지를 보고 오염 때문에 슬퍼졌어요.
Then everyone wore gloves and picked up trash along the bank for two hours.
그다음에 모두 장갑을 끼고 두 시간 동안 강둑을 따라 쓰레기를 주웠어요.
After that, a writer took photos, and the story appeared in the town newspaper.
그 뒤에 한 작가가 사진을 찍었고, 그 이야기는 마을 신문에 실렸어요.
Finally, their teacher wanted to congratulate every helper, so she gave them cold juice.
마지막으로 선생님은 도와준 모두를 축하하고 싶어서 차가운 주스를 나눠 주셨어요.
On the way home, Amy was tired, but she felt proud of the clean river.
집에 돌아가는 길에 에이미는 피곤했지만 깨끗해진 강이 자랑스러웠어요.
ox: Tom and Amy went to the river by themselves.

s: Last week, Minsu's class chose Mina as the new class representative.
지난주에 민수네 반은 미나를 새 반 대표로 뽑았어요.
First, Mina felt nervous because she had no experience with speaking to the whole school.
먼저 미나는 전교생 앞에서 말해 본 경험이 없어서 긴장했어요.
Then she had a long conversation with Jiho, who gave her a few helpful tips.
그다음에 미나는 지호와 긴 대화를 나눴고, 지호는 도움이 되는 조언을 몇 가지 해 주었어요.
After that, she practiced in front of the mirror until the words felt familiar.
그 뒤에 미나는 말이 입에 익을 때까지 거울 앞에서 연습했어요.
Finally, Mina stood on the stage and spoke clearly to all the students.
마지막으로 미나는 무대에 서서 모든 학생에게 또렷하게 말했어요.

모두가 박수를 쳤고, 미나는 첫 큰 발표가 기뻤어요.

s: Last summer, Amy and her dad took a ship across the Atlantic.
지난여름에 에이미와 아빠는 배를 타고 대서양을 건넜어요.
First, they waited at the port, because the departure was at noon.
먼저 두 사람은 출발이 정오여서 항구에서 기다렸어요.
Then they met a tourist from Canada, and they talked about their favorite cities.
그다음에 두 사람은 캐나다에서 온 관광객을 만나 가장 좋아하는 도시들에 대해 이야기했어요.
After that, the sea became rough, and Amy could hardly walk on the deck.
그 뒤에 바다가 거칠어져서 에이미는 갑판 위에서 거의 걸을 수 없었어요.
Finally, the waves became calm, and everyone watched the sunset together.
마지막으로 파도가 잔잔해졌고 모두 함께 해넘이를 보았어요.
Amy wrote in her diary that it was the best trip of her life.
에이미는 일기에 그것이 평생 최고의 여행이었다고 썼어요.
ox: Amy and her dad traveled by airplane.
에이미와 아빠는 비행기로 여행했어요.

에이미는 배에서 캐나다에서 온 관광객과 이야기했어요.

q: Where would you go if you took a long trip by ship?
배로 긴 여행을 간다면 어디에 갈래?
ex: I would cross the Atlantic with my family and take many photos.
나는 가족과 함께 대서양을 건너 사진을 많이 찍을 거예요.

s: Last spring, Minsu's class started a small garden behind the school.
지난봄에 민수네 반은 학교 뒤에 작은 정원을 시작했어요.
First, they put a flyer on the wall to ask for help from other classes.
먼저 아이들은 다른 반에 도움을 청하려고 벽에 전단지를 붙였어요.
Then every student planted a seed in a wooden box, and the table became a mess.
그다음에 모든 학생이 나무 상자마다 씨앗을 심었고, 탁자는 엉망이 되었어요.
After that, they cleaned up and watered the plants at regular times each week.
그 뒤에 아이들은 청소를 하고 매주 정해진 시간에 식물에 물을 주었어요.
Finally, in June, the small plants grew tall, and the class achieved its goal.
마침내 6월에 작은 식물들이 키 크게 자랐고, 반은 목표를 이루었어요.
Everyone shared the first tomatoes at lunch and felt very proud.
모두가 점심시간에 첫 토마토를 나눠 먹고 아주 뿌듯해했어요.

ex: I would plant a sunflower seed and water it every day.

s: Last summer, Tom and Jiho visited their grandparents in a small village by the sea.
지난여름에 톰과 지호는 바닷가의 작은 마을에 사시는 조부모님을 찾아갔어요.
First, they rode their scooters along the beach road before breakfast.
먼저 두 사람은 아침 식사 전에 해변 길을 따라 스쿠터를 탔어요.
Then they jumped over every wave near the shore, and Tom saw a jellyfish far away.
그다음에 두 사람은 해안 근처에서 파도를 하나하나 뛰어넘었고, 톰은 멀리서 해파리를 보았어요.
After that, they walked back to the house, and Jiho felt an ache in his legs.
그 뒤에 두 사람은 집으로 걸어 돌아왔고, 지호는 다리가 쑤시는 것을 느꼈어요.
Finally, their grandmother gave them warm soup, and the boys rested on the porch.
마지막으로 할머니가 따뜻한 수프를 주셨고, 두 소년은 현관에서 쉬었어요.
Before bed, Tom said the trip was the best one of the year.
자기 전에 톰은 이번 여행이 올해 최고의 여행이었다고 말했어요.
